nodes.label: Mobile App Scope Redesign Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Plan to introduce database-driven scope-based navigation with ScopeShell, ScopeHubScreen, and per-scope components.

nodes.label: Scope Model
nodes.rationale: Database-driven model storing slug, label, icon, color, gradient, tabs, is_active, sort_order for mobile feature scopes.

nodes.label: ScopeRoleAccess Model
nodes.rationale: Pivot model linking scopes to Spatie role names; controls which roles see which scopes.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/scope-config
nodes.rationale: API endpoint returning scopes allowed for the authenticated user, including visual config and summary stats.

nodes.label: IndexedDB Version 7
nodes.rationale: Adds scopeConfig store to cache database-driven navigation configuration for offline use.
